data.one_liner: Flutter extensions to remove boilerplate when accessing ancestor context properties.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of Dart extension methods on BuildContext, String, and numbers to simplify common boilerplate operations. It streamlines access to sizes, text styles, colors, themes, platform info, navigation, and string manipulation.
use_when: You want to reduce boilerplate when accessing MediaQuery, Theme, or Navigator properties via BuildContext
You prefer concise extension syntax for navigating and styling within Flutter apps
avoid_when: You prefer avoiding custom extension methods to keep code standard and explicit
You only need a single isolated helper and want to avoid adding a dependency for utilities
strengths: Significantly reduces lines of code for common BuildContext lookups
Organized into clean categories like sizes, textStyles, colors, and themes
Includes helpful string and duration extensions
weaknesses: Relies entirely on extensions, which might conflict or pollute namespace if not managed carefully
Requires keeping track of the specific extension groups available
data.setup_notes: Just add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package.
